reasons: The range uses a fixed [5m] window; only $__rate_interval is allowed.
The Datadog query returns the raw docker.net.bytes_sent value (no rate or rollup), but the candidate applies rate(), which changes the quantity to bytes per second.

The OTel metric has an 'interface' attribute and is per-interface, while Datadog reports one total per container. avg by (container_name) averages across interfaces instead of summing them, so the aggregation is wrong.
The candidate should be an exact translation without rate(), using sum by (container_name) over the selector with $__rate_interval removed.
The $scope template variable has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct.
Labels are observed as container_name, so the grouping label is valid.
